label: main season
summary: Recommend further non-technical survey. The team's observation is evidence of absence limited to the paths and field edges observed, while E2 is a weak, vague second-hand report (reliability class 7) that remains unexplained. There is no direct or qualifying target evidence for clearance, and cancellation criteria are not met; national criteria require follow-up of weaker indirect evidence, with clearance considered if it remains unexplained after two visits.
flags: The zone survey flag and priority are not evidence and were not used to determine the outcome.

E2's reported incident is not precisely located and is relayed through a bus driver; seek clarification from community members who may have first-hand knowledge and assess land use/safe use history on further survey.

checks.detail: Further non-technical survey is always open.

E1.quote: The survey team walked the paths and field edges of the area and saw no items, signs, fencing or other marks of contamination.
E1.note: The survey team's own observation supports absence of visible indicators in the paths and field edges it surveyed; it does not establish safe use over time or account for the separate vague report.

E2.quote: A bus driver said neighbours told him that an animal was killed by a mine somewhere in the area some years ago.
E2.note: This is an unverified, vague second-hand report with an unidentified first-hand source and no determinable location; it suggests possible EO but does not confirm it.
